articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Local Pore Modeling and Gas Mass Transfer Simulation in Electrochemical CO2 Reduction Catalyst Layers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The electrochemical <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{CO}_{2}$</tex> reduction reaction (CO2RR) is a promising approach to combat climate change, with the catalyst layer (CL) of membrane electrode assemblies playing a crucial role in both the reaction and mass transfer. Traditional methods have limitations, as experimental measurements of the internal environment are difficult, and most simulation models treat the CL as a whole, ignoring its local pore structure. This work thus develops a local pore model of the CL using deep learning techniques to examine the effects of different ionomer contents on gas mass transfer. Results align well with existing studies: the CL with an I/C ratio of 0.2 has the highest gas diffusion distance (679.53 nm), indicating optimal mass transfer; the CL with an I/C ratio of 0.6 has the largest silver catalyst surface area, reflecting the highest number of active sites; and the CL with an I/C ratio of 0.4 shows the highest CO concentration in the high-concentration region, suggesting a balance of mass transfer and reaction efficiency. This model could serve as a useful tool and pathway to offer valuable insights for optimizing CL design and then improving the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{CO}_{2}$</tex> RR performance.

articleTitle: A Review of Research on Low Carbon Evaluation System Based on Distribution Network Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The distribution network transformer serves as an indispensable core component within the power transmission and distribution system, playing a vital role in facilitating the transition of the power system towards a low-carbon future. This emphasizes the critical importance of establishing a scientifically robust low-carbon evaluation framework to enhance system reliability, mitigate environmental impacts, and expedite the adoption of clean energy. This study systematically analyzes the influence of various transformer failure modes on the construction of the low-carbon evaluation framework and subsequently develops a model for assessing the low-carbon status of distribution network transformers. Additionally, different low-carbon assessment methodologies are explored, highlighting their distinct advantages and limitations in evaluating the low-carbon performance of distribution transformers. By integrating these approaches with practical application needs, a scientifically sound carbon emission grading evaluation index system for distribution network transformers is proposed, providing essential guidance for selecting low-carbon evaluation methods. This contributes to ensuring the safe and stable operation of electrical equipment and promotes the low-carbon development of distribution network transformers.

articleTitle: Electricity Spot Market Price Forecasting by Using LSTM Optimized by ETO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: As renewable energy resources rapidly develop and electricity markets undergo continuous reforms, the forecasting of electricity spot market price has become increasingly critical. Accurate price forecasting not only aids market participants in formulating more effective trading strategies but also enhances the operational efficiency of power systems. This study proposes a forecasting methodology for electricity spot market price based on Long Short-Term Memory neural networks (LSTM) optimized by Exponential-Trigonometric Optimization (ETO) algorithm to improve prediction accuracy. The LSTM-based forecasting model capable of capturing long-term dependencies within time series data is employed. Meanwhile, the ETO algorithm is employed for the optimization of the hyperparameters of the LSTM model, thereby mitigating overfitting and enhancing the model's adaptability and generalization capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that the LSTM model optimized by ETO algorithm for electricity spot market price forecasting outperforms compared forecasting methods across performance metrics including MAPE, RMSE and MAE, which verifies the proposed forecasting model is effective and practical in this paper. This research not only provides effective decision-support tools for electricity market participants but also offers new perspectives and methodologies for future studies in electricity price forecasting.

articleTitle: Detection Method for Insulating Gas Leakage of Combined Electrical Appliances based on Mutual Sensing Feature and Nuclear Bias Least Squares
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: When detecting the insulation gas leakage of the combined electrical appliances, the reliability of the detection results is low due to the influence of noise interference in the combined electrical appliances. Therefore, the detection method of the combined electrical appliances based on the mutual inductive feature and the nuclear least squares is proposed. Design the acquisition method based on the principle of the mutual induction. In the stage of combined electrical insulation gas leakage detection, the problem in a limited space (combined electrical data), with the mapping function to determine the presence of gas leakage status, an indirect way-nuclear least squares, to calculate the partial derivative of the variable (combined electrical data) and mapping function (gas leakage state), to realize the accurate detection of the combined electrical insulation gas leakage. In the test results, the effective detection rate of the designed detection method is stable above 95.0%, the false detection rate is less than 3.0%, and the missed detection rate is less than 2.0%, with high reliability.

articleTitle: Optimal Method of Minimum Start-Up Mode for Conventional Units Considering Multi-Factor Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of external power supply and the installed capacity of new energy, the start-up mode for conventional units of the receiver power grid network is gradually decreasing, and the minimum start-up sequence needs to be optimized in order to maintain the stability of the power grid. In this paper, the key factors affecting the minimum start-up units are extracted, and the quantitative indicators of the multi-feed short-circuit ratio of new energy, the electrical distance between the generator and the weak node, and the dynamic reactive power response of the generator are extracted, which are used to characterize the support ability of the power grid unit start-up mode to the system voltage stability. Then, with the goal of optimizing the above indicators, considering the operation constraints of conventional units and new energy units, the minimum start-up optimization model of the power grid is established to determine the minimum start-up sequence of the power grid. Finally, taking the actual power grid in China as an example, the simulation proves the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Stability Improvement Method of Inverter Based on Dynamic Decoupling of Grid Impedance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The interaction between the AC weak grid and photovoltaic inverters may introduce disturbance branches into the system. This paper establishes a small-signal model of the grid-connected system and derives the impedance model and synchronous loop model, revealing the dynamic disturbance branches and instability mechanisms caused by grid impedance. Different from traditional methods, this paper proposes a stability enhancement method based on dynamic decoupling of grid impedance using the constructed synchronous loop model. This method can decouple the dynamics of grid impedance from those of the inverter, ensuring stable operation of the grid-connected system even under wide variations in grid impedance and in extremely weak grid conditions, without transient oscillations during the transient process, and demonstrating robustness against parameter deviations. Finally, a simulation platform was built in MATLAB/Simulink to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method and to test its robustness.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Fusion Method for Multi-Spatio-Temporal Fault Data of Photovoltaic Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: In this paper, an unsupervised fusion method for multi-spatio-temporal fault data of photovoltaic power station is proposed. The method is based on artificial intelligence technology, the invention aims to solve the problems of data distribution deviation and multi-source domain data fusion in the fault analysis of a photovoltaic power station. Fusing tagged PV station data constructs a fault analysis model for new stations, reducing training time and improving fault analysis efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Power Outage Research Method Based on Multi-Source Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the great increase of people's demand for electricity, intelligent power system is the future development trend of power enterprises.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> The fast and accurate research and judgment of power failure events has become the key to ensure the reliability of power supply and user satisfaction. This paper discusses the power outage research and judgment method of “multi-source system integrated research and judgment + dynamic correction” based on multi-source data. First, the article analyzes the limitations of traditional methods for power system outage assessment. Second, by combining OGG technology and big data analysis, the article completes the collection and preprocessing of data from multiple sources, including power supply service command platform, electricity consumption information collection system, transformer terminals, distribution automation system, dispatch automation system, and centralized control platform. It then explains the process of cross-verification, deduplication, and dynamic correction for data from different sources based on priority levels. Next, by using a hierarchical star topology, the article establishes a “multi-source system comprehensive assessment + dynamic correction” model for power outage assessment, and uses cross-validation methods to adjust model parameters to improve the model's generalization ability. Finally, through experimental design and result analysis, the article verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed model, and trains the model to improve its accuracy and coverage. The research results not only significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of power outage information, but also enable full-scale perception of customer-side power outages and proactive research on service risks, providing innovative solutions for the stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Voltage Stress Analysis of Devices in Actively Commutated CSC- HVDC during DC fault
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: HVDC transmission based on actively commutated current source converter (CSC-HVDC) is a promising technology with no commutation failure risk and a relatively small footprint. However, the RB-IGCT in the converter may suffer from voltage over-stress after a DC fault, which could threaten the operation safety. Therefore, this paper analyzes the voltage stress of CSC-HVDC after fault and derives the analytical expression of the commutation capacitor's voltage during the transient process, which can be used to determine the voltage stress. A voltage stress suppressing method is also proposed and validated through PSCAD/EMTDC simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Volume Monitoring Method of Concentrated Gas in Gas Relays for Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: As the most important non electric protection device for transformers, gas relays play a crucial role in ensuring the safe and stable operation of transformers. With the increase of operating years, the number of defects and abnormal problems in transformers is gradually increasing. However, it is difficult to obtain the true volume of gas accumulation during light gas alarms, making it difficult to determine whether there is a false alarm. It is necessary to quickly organize substation operation and inspection personnel to carry out on-site inspections of gas volume accumulation in gas relays, analysis and testing of dissolved gases in oil, and other work. This article addresses the above issues by using a capacitive liquid level sensor to achieve detection of liquid level height with a maximum deviation of less than 0.3%. A gas volume calculation model was established based on the dense point calibration method, and on-site actual light gas volume monitoring with a maximum deviation of less than 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> was successfully completed. The relevant achievements of this article have solved the problem of not being able to determine whether there is a false alarm during the light gas action of oil immersed transformers, and can provide data support for operation and maintenance personnel to grasp the real operating status of the equipment and formulate targeted operation and maintenance strategies.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Influence of the Line Impedance Angle of MMC-VSG on the Power Transmission Limit
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the rapid development of the new energy industry, the problems faced by high-proportion new energy transmission systems in terms of transmission capacity and stability have become increasingly severe. This paper analyzes the impact of the modular multilevel converter-based virtual synchronous generator (MMC-VSG) on it. Firstly, the topological structure of the MMC and the control strategy diagram of the VSG are introduced in detail. Secondly, it deeply analyzes how the power transmission limit of the VSG affects the transient power angle stability. Furthermore, through formula derivation, the inherent relationship between the line impedance angle and the power transmission limit is revealed. Finally, the corresponding simulation model is built with the help of MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results clearly show that reducing the line impedance angle can effectively improve the power output limit of the VSG and also expand the stable range of the output voltage. This finding is of crucial significance for ensuring the safe and stable operation of new energy transmission systems and improving their transmission capacity.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Prediction Based on Multiple Decompositions and WOA-LSSVM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: In response to the significant uncertainty of wind power and the limitations of a single model in capturing the nonlinear characteristics of signals, this paper introduces a wind power prediction model based on multiple decompositions and the Least Squares Support Vector Machines (LSSVM) optimized by the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA), referred to as the WOA-LSSVM model. In this model, the raw wind power data is initially decomposed using the Complete Ensemble Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) to obtain several Intrinsic Mode Functions. Subsequently, the sample entropy of each component is calculated, and these Intrinsic Mode Functions are classified into three components: high, medium, and low frequency, using K-means clustering. The Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) is then employed to further process the high-frequency components. Finally, the processed data is fed into the LSSVM, and the hyperparameters of the LSSVM are fine-tuned using the WOA algorithm. Experimental results based on measured data from a wind farm in Turkey reveal that, in comparison to other models, the proposed model exhibits the highest determination coefficient, the smallest root mean square error, and the lowest mean absolute error, demonstrating its suitability for short-term wind power prediction.

articleTitle: TCN-SGConv-LSTM with Attention Mechanism for Power Load Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The goal of this study is to improve power load forecasting accuracy through the integration of the Time Convolutional Network (TCN), Structured Global Convolution (SGConv), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) modules. The proposed model, TCN-SGConv-LSTM, leverages TCN for capturing long-term temporal dependencies and combines the memory capabilities of LSTM with SGConv to enhance global feature extraction. The model further integrates the Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) attention mechanism to better recognize key features. Experiments using power load data from central air conditioners of a mall, electric vehicle charging station, and energy storage station demonstrate superior performance over traditional LSTM and TCN-LSTM models, significantly reducing the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). This approach offers a new and practical solution for power load forecasting with broad potential applications.

articleTitle: The Influence of Hydrophilicity and Current Density of Anode PorousTransport Layer on Two-Phase Transport in Polymer Electrolyte Membrane Water Electrolysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Due to the opposite flow direction of gas and liquid inside anode porous transport layer (PTL) of polymer electrolyte membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE), gas hinders the transportation of liquids, thereby reducing the liquid saturation in PTL which is a crucial manifestation of the anode catalyst layer (CL) liquid supply. Liquid saturation is affected by factors such as the thickness of the transport layer and the current density. This study established a gas-liquid two-phase transport model for the anode porous transport layer in polymer electrolyte membrane water electrolysis and studies the variation of liquid saturation inside PTL under different hydrophilicity and current densities. The results show as the current density increases, the critical liquid transport thickness gradually decreases; the improvement of hydrophilicity has a significant enhancing effect on liquid transport. Increasing the hydrophilicity of PTL can significantly increase the saturation of liquid.

articleTitle: Determination and Comparative Study on the Thermal Conductivity of Silicone-Based Heat Transfer Media
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Silicon-based heat transfer media has advantages in the field of trough solar thermal power generation because of its wide operating temperature range. The thermal conductivity is also a key parameter for system. The transient hot wire method is adopted in this article to determine the thermal conductivity of silicon-based heat transfer media within the temperature range of 100°C-340°C. To ensure the accuracy and reliability of the measurements, n-dodecane and n-octadecane are selected as the standard reference substances in the temperature ranges of 100°C- 220°C and 200°C- 340°C, the experimental errors are controlled within 1.3% and 5.0%. Under these conditions, the thermal conductivity of silicon-based, dibenzyltoluene and hydrogenated terphenyl heat transfer media are measured and compared, which provides a basis for the selection of high-temperature heat transfer media.

articleTitle: Research on Stress Assessment Methods for Steam Generator Outlet Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: This paper aims to study stress assessment methods for steam generator outlet pipelines to ensure the safe operation of power stations. It describes the distributed self-weight condition and the slack cold condition. The distributed self-weight condition considers the total weight of the pipeline system and distributes the total weight load to each support and hanger. The slack cold condition simulates the process of the pipeline transitioning from a hot to a cold working state, calculating the displacement and stress caused by thermal expansion and contraction. The model focuses on the steam pipeline extending from the outlet of the steam generator to the inlet of the turbine. The distribution of distributed loads and structural loads, as well as the distribution of working loads and cold displacements, and working loads and thermal displacements, has been calculated. The results indicate that the calculated primary and secondary stresses fall within the allowable stress range. The paper summarizes the stress assessment process for steam pipelines, including defining assessment objectives, collecting pipeline information, selecting appropriate software, creating geometric models of pipelines, setting constraint nodes, calculating load conditions, obtaining stress and displacement data, and verifying whether the stresses meet standard requirements. Through the use of reasonable calculation models and stress analysis, the behavior characteristics of pipelines under different conditions can be evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Early Warning and Power Outage Prediction Model in Residential Quarters
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the expansion of the power grid and the development of the power market, power companies are facing challenges in customer service risk. Especially in recent years, large-scale power outages caused by natural disasters, weather abnormalities, power equipment failures and other reasons in some areas of China have fully exposed the shortcomings of the current power system in risk warning and disaster response. These power outages have seriously affected the normal life of residents and may even cause a series of social problems. Improving the prediction accuracy of weather-related outages in the distribution system is crucial for disaster prevention and mitlgation‘!’. Based on this, in order to improve the accuracy of risk prediction, enhance the disaster emergency response ability and reduce the workload of grass-roots units, this study intends to study the risk early warning and power failure prediction model. In urban distribution networks, outages are divided into two categories: planned outages and unplanned fault outages, and this study mainly focuses on the latter, that is, those outages that have not been arranged in advance, approved or notified to users. By adopting the technology of “minimized accurate acquisition + digital system calculation”, combined with OGG technology and big data analysis, we monitor six types of power outage-related abnormal data, predict the number of power outage users and give early warning. At the same time, big data and machine learning technology are used to improve prediction accuracy and develop real-time monitoring and early warning systems. The results of this research are of great significance to improve power reliability, reduce the burden of grassroots, and enhance disaster response capabilities.

articleTitle: Distribution network topology identification method based on SMOTE-TCN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the construction of new power system, distributed energy and charging piles are connected in large quantities, which makes the topology of distribution network more complicated. At present, there is a lack of effective topology identification methods for distribution network stations. In this paper, a time convolutional neural network is proposed to identify the dependency relationship between the user and the station area, it provides the basis for judging the three-phase unbalance of the platform area. In view of the problems of low quality and imbalance data, SMOTE data processing algorithm is used to deal with the imbalance data. The experimental results show that: The combination of SMOTE data processing and temporal convolutional neural network algorithm can effectively identify the user's station area. The average identification accuracy rate of all stations reached 89.31%, and the recall rate reached 89.36%.

articleTitle: An Improved Cloud Image-Solar Irradiance Ultra-Short-Term Forecasting Model Based on DRL and RBFNN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The motion characteristics of clouds can lead to sudden changes in photovoltaic power. And to accurately predict the power of distributed photovoltaics, it is first necessary to accurately predict the ultra-short-term solar irradiance received at the surface with construction of an ultra-short-term solar irradiance forecasting model based on cloud image features. During the cloud image data processing, the data is firstly standardized, and the intra-day variability of it is reduced by suppressing the influence of the solar altitude angle on the pixel intensity of cloud images. On this basis, a centroid algorithm is used to predict the cloud images for a ultra-short period in the future; then Deep Residual Learning (DRL) is proposed to extract cloud image features. These features are combined with other influencing factors to form an input feature vector, and put into Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) model to obtain the surface radiation forecasting results. Experimental results show that the model can accurately predict the intensity of solar radiation received by the surface of a set area.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Safety Clearance of Live Working in UHV Line Based on Medium Helicopter Hanging Basket Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of UHV transmission line helicopter in live working, a test study on safety gap in live working is carried out. Combined with the working characteristics, basket and UHV line parameters based on the helicopter live working with suspension method, 4 typical working conditions were analyzed and defined. The test platform was built according to the ratio of 1: 1 and the shock discharge characteristic curve of air gap operation in each typical working condition was obtained through the ground and phase discharge tests. The minimum phase-ground and phase-to-phase safety gap value of helicopter live working with suspension method in 1000kV UHV line is determined and the research results provide a technical basis for carrying out live working safely.

articleTitle: Fault Identification of Bearing Vibration Signals Under Different Loads Based on Isolation Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the continuous development of industrial equipment, vibration signals have become an important tool for monitoring the operational status of machinery, widely used in fault diagnosis and health monitoring. Traditional anomaly detection methods face significant limitations when handling high-dimensional vibration signals. To improve the accuracy and robustness of anomaly detection in vibration signals, this study proposes an anomaly detection method based on the Isolation Forest (IF) algorithm. This research utilizes performance test data of asynchronous motor bearings from a motor factory. The dataset includes vibration signals, temperature signals, and voltage signals under different load conditions. The Isolation Forest algorithm is applied to detect anomalies in vibration signals, accurately identifying potential fault signals. Results show that the Isolation Forest algorithm achieves remarkable effectiveness in detecting abnormal bearing vibration signals under various load conditions.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electrical Properties of Line Zinc Oxide Arrester Based on Entropy Weight Method for Electrothermal Aging
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: In this paper, a 1000 h electrothermal aging test was carried out on the line arrester (MOA), the effect of electrothermal aging on its electrical performance was studied, and the decomposition of the aging arrester was carried out. The results show that with the increase of electrothermal aging time, the leakage current at 0.75 times U1mA.DC gradually decreases, and the total current and resistive current components of the arrester show a decreasing trend under the continuous operating voltage. The dismantling examination showed that the color of the epoxy cylinder deepened, and there were many microcracks on the surface, and the SEM test showed that the porosity of the zinc oxide valve plate increased after aging. In this paper, the entropy weight method is used to calculate the weights of key electrical features in the process of electrothermal aging, which can provide a basis for accurately evaluating the state of zinc oxide arresters in the line.

articleTitle: A Novel Variable Exponential Power Sliding Mode Observer for MMC
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Modular multilevel converters are widely used due to large power density, high efficiency, and strong scalability. Thousands of submodules have led to an increasing number of capacitor voltage measurement devices, making the hardware structure complex, bulky, and expensive. This article proposes a variable exponential power sliding mode observer that can observe capacitor voltage and bridge arm current without any voltage measurement equipment, eliminating the inherent sliding mode chattering of traditional sliding mode observers under sudden changes in DC side voltage. It can also ensure a high degree of observation accuracy under parameter mismatch (capacitor preburning and inductance mismatch), proving the convergence law of observation errors. And through Simulink simulation and MMC hardware prototype construction, the effectiveness of the proposed observation technique was verified by comparing it with traditional power-exponential observers.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Control Strategies Based on Microgrid Power Mutual Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: To meet the development needs of new-type distribution networks, this paper proposes a distributed hierarchical control strategy based on honeycomb-like distribution network topology. Initially, we define the relevant concepts of microgrids (MGs) and establish a multi-layer control architecture based on the honeycomb-shaped distribution network. Subsequently, the paper designs methods for autonomous operation and hierarchical running of each MG area: each MG formulates day-ahead operation plans according to its own source-load characteristics; MGs achieve interaction of energy and information through base stations, while the distribution network operation center adopts the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) as a distributed algorithm to realize power allocation among MGs; MGs connect with the distribution network via connection points to satisfy their energy balance. Finally, through case studies, the proposed control strategy is verified to alleviate the control burden of distribution network operators.

articleTitle: Study on the Thermal Cracking and Gas Generation at the Insulation Interface of High-Voltage Cable Intermediate Joints
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The intermediate joint of high-voltage cables, as a key component for connecting cables, plays a crucial role in the reliability of the system, which directly impacts the stability and safety of the power grid. However, due to the special installation location and complex installation process of the high-voltage cable intermediate joints, they are more prone to overheating, discharge phenomena, and even explosion accidents. Cable intermediate j oint failures primarily originate from interface discharge at the interface between silicone rubber (SiR) and cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulation. Therefore, this paper investigates the gas generation phenomenon at the insulation interface of high-voltage cable intermediate joints during the discharge-induced thermal cracking process. First, the gas generation mechanism under the temperature rise due to discharge at the SiR-XLPE interface of the cable intermediate j oint is analyzed. Then, discharge-induced thermal cracking tests at the SiR-XLPE insulation interface are conducted, with the generated gases being collected and analyzed for their composition. Finally, a simplified model of heat generation and temperature rise in the discharge channel at the insulation interface is established. The results show that the temperature in the discharge channel at the insulation interface is much higher than the thermal cracking temperature of the material, leading to the thermal cracking of the insulation material and the generation of gas.

articleTitle: Application Study of Low-Pass Filtering PID Algorithm in Single-Phase Inverter Current Loop
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: For the suppression of high-frequency harmonics in the current loop of single-phase inverters, it is difficult for traditional methods to meet the requirements of high accuracy and fast response. In this paper, an innovative low-pass filtering PID control algorithm is proposed, which combines the voltage outer-loop and current inner-loop control architectures to effectively filter out the high-frequency harmonics in the output of the inverter, and realize the precise regulation. This algorithm significantly improves the voltage stability and dynamic response speed of the inverter under the complex grid, and enhances the system robustness. At the same time, this paper elaborates the optimization design principle of PID feedback parameters, and verifies its effectiveness and practicability through simulation experiments, which provides solid theoretical and experimental support for the application of low-pass filtering PID algorithms in single-phase inverter current loop.

articleTitle: Density Functional Theory Investigation of Direct Zscheme Cadmium Oxide /Blue Phosphorene Heterojunction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The urgent need for renewable energy solutions has driven research into advanced photocatalysts capable of efficiently harnessing solar energy. Z-scheme heterojunctions, known for their excellent charge separation and redox capabilities, have emerged as promising candidates. In this study, we constructed a two-dimensional Z-scheme heterojunction based on cadmium oxide (CdO) and blue phosphorene (BlueP). Using state-of-the-art density functional theory (DFT) simulations, we systematically investigated the structural, electronic, and photocatalytic properties of this heterojunction. The projected band (PBAND) structure reveals that the heterojunction exhibits a staggered band alignment. Specifically, the conduction band minimum (CBM) of CdO is lower than that of BlueP, while the valence band maximum (VBM) of BlueP is higher than that of CdO. This unique band structure enables an efficient transfer and recombination of photogenerated excitons between the CBM of CdO and the VBM of BlueP, while maintaining more reductive photoexcited electrons in the CBM of BlueP and more oxidative holes in the VBM of CdO layer. Moreover, the charge density distribution analysis demonstrates an interfacial built-in electric field from BlueP to CdO layer, further accelerating the exciton separation and migration. Consequently, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{CdO} / \text{BlueP} \quad$</tex> Z-scheme heterojunction demonstrated enhanced charge separation efficiency and prolonged carrier lifetimes, which are essential for high photocatalytic activity. Our study highlights the potential of this material for advanced photocatalytic applications and provides a foundation for further exploration of two-dimensional Z-scheme heterojunctions in the pursuit of renewable energy solutions.

articleTitle: Frequency Support Timing Sequence Coordination Optimization for Energy Storage Inverter Cluster
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: This paper proposes a frequency support (FS) strategy for energy storage (ES) inverter clusters that considers timing sequence collaborative optimization. Based on predicted grid frequency regulation instructions, different working modes of ES inverter clusters are optimized in advance through sequence optimization to reduce ES losses while ensuring FS capability. A FS optimization model for ES inverter clusters has been established, which utilizes power optimization to manage the charging and discharging energy of ES participating in frequency regulation to reduce power deviation during frequency regulation and achieve power balance, and further enhance the FS capability. Simulation studies have verified that the proposed strategy can improve the economic benefits of ES while ensuring FS capability.

articleTitle: Transformer-Based Theoretical Power Fitting Method for Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Dust accumulation on photovoltaic modules is a key factor limiting the power generation efficiency of solar PV systems. The accuracy of theoretical power calculations directly affects the evaluation of dust loss. Traditional theoretical power formulas have certain limitations in expressing the deep nonlinear relationships between input and output, resulting in lower accuracy of the calculated theoretical power. To address this, this paper proposes a photovoltaic power generation theoretical power fitting method based on Transformer, which combines meteorological data to fit the power generation of cleaned PV panels daily. Experiments conducted under both overall and three distinct weather conditions show that, compared to traditional theoretical power formulas, the proposed method demonstrates superior performance, providing strong support for the intelligent operation and optimized scheduling of PV power generation systems.

articleTitle: Research on the Monitoring Method of Fault Characteristic Gas Composition in Gas Relays for Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Gas relays are the key equipment that provides non electric protection function for transformers. At present, after the light gas alarm, the operation and inspection personnel are unable to detect the gas composition in the first time, making it difficult to determine the specific type of malfunction. This article proposes a gas composition detection device for gas relays based on the principles of gas chromatography and gas fixatives, and analyzes the adsorption and desorption rates of different gases and the detection accuracy of gases with different concentrations through experiments. The experimental data shows that the adsorption and desorption rates of different gases within different concentration ranges are all greater than 85%, and the detection deviation of each gas is less than 6%, which can meet the on-site requirements. The relevant research results of this article are beneficial for operation and inspection personnel to timely detect and determine the type of fault, facilitate faster handling of faults, and ensure the reliable and stable operation of power transformers.

articleTitle: A Multi-VSG Parallel Control Strategy Based on Fuzzy PID and Center of Inertia Frequency
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Aiming at the oscillation issues arising during load mutation in multi-virtual synchronous generator (VSG) parallel control systems, this paper introduces a multi-VSG parallel control strategy based on fuzzy PID and center of inertia (COI) frequency, which can effectively suppress oscillations in the transient process and enhance system stability. Firstly, a small-signal model of the multi-VSG parallel system is established to analyze the mechanisms of system oscillations. Secondly, a fuzzy PID controller combined with COI frequency estimation is constructed and applied to the active power control loop of VSGs to improve the system's transient stability. Finally, simulation comparisons are conducted to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed oscillation suppression strategy.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Prediction Model for Smart Energy Cities Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: As the environmental protection situation is becoming increasingly serious, the environmental pollution caused by the carbon emissions of urban power users has become a common concern. Aiming at the problems of low accuracy and difficult parameter optimization of the current carbon emission prediction model for power users, a carbon emission prediction model PSO-CNN-LSTM based on the denoising of wavelet packet decomposition (WPD) is proposed. Firstly, wavelet packet decomposition is used to denoise the modeling data, and then the CNN-LSTM model is constructed to predict the carbon emission data. The CNN-LSTM model is then built to predict the carbon emission data. In order to solve the problem of the difficult selection of hyperparameters for the model, the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to search for the optimal hyperparameter combinations for the model iteratively. It is verified that the proposed PSO-CNN-LSTM model based on WPD denoising is optimal in all four evaluation indexes and has a stronger generalization ability, which indicates that the model can be applied to the prediction of carbon emissions of urban electricity consumers.

articleTitle: Fault Vibration Detection of Power Transformer Winding Core Based on $\varphi$-OTDR Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: As a key component of power transformers, the vibration characteristics of the winding core will also change when it fails. To ensure the safe operation of power transformers and detect the fault vibration of power transformer winding iron core, a method for detecting the fault vibration of power transformer winding iron core based on φ-OTDR sensing is proposed. The φ-OTDR technology utilizes the phase sensitive characteristics of optical fibers to perform high-precision detection of vibrations along the fiber. Propose an installation method of embedding sensing optical fibers into power transformer windings, using the optical fiber through plate at the oil change valve of the power transformer to extract the optical signals inside the power transformer. And vibration testing experiments were conducted on different types of faults in combination with a 220 kV real power transformer. The experimental results show that the designed φ-OTDR sensing system in this paper can achieve vibration detection of different types of faults in the iron core of power transformer windings, laying the foundation for subsequent use in fault type identification and fault level classification of power transformer winding iron cores.

articleTitle: Extension and Validation of ATHLET Code for Thermal Energy Storage Simulation with Solar Salt
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: This article introduces the workflow of extending the ATHLET code to use solar salt as a thermal energy storage (TES) medium and its validation with the model of a natural circulation loop test facility. Thanks to ATHLET's modular structure, a plug-in was developed to implement the thermophysical properties of molten salts. The binary nitrate mixture solar salt was widely used in concentrated solar power (CSP) storage, considering its high cost-performance ratio, thermal stability, and broad operational window. To validate the code extension and implementation of salt properties, a simulation model was developed on the basis of Molten Salt Natural Circulation Loop (MSNCL) Testing. Both steady states and flow initiation transients were performed with a series of initial power levels in A THLET. Through comparison of the results and analysis of the thermal-hydraulic phenomena, the extension of ATHLET and the implementation of the salt's thermophysical properties were validated. The thermal dynamic behaviors of the MSNCL model can also reflect the characteristics of a scaled-up CSP system. This study represents the possibility of extending and utilizing a nuclear code in the field of renewable energy and further for broader applications across various energy systems.

articleTitle: Optimization of Smart Fishing Ground with Photovoltaic Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Driven by the “double carbon” policy, traditional fisheries are transforming to smart low-carbon fisheries, in which the application of photovoltaic energy storage system provides key technical support. This study explores an optimization method for coordination between photovoltaic energy storage system and fishery energy demand, aiming at realizing low-carbon operation of fishery. By rationally allocating photovoltaic power generation capacity and adjusting energy storage strategies, it is possible to maximize solar energy utilization efficiency and significantly reduce dependence on the grid while ensuring the normal operation of fisheries. This approach not only optimizes energy management, but also further promotes the low-carbon development of fisheries by reducing the cost of electricity purchase on the grid. The experimental results show that the optimization strategy can significantly improve the energy efficiency, reduce the operating cost and carbon emission of the fishery, and provide effective technical support and practical guidance for the low-carbon intelligent transformation of the fishery.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy of the Fault Reconstruction and Repair of Distribution Network Based on Improved Harris Hawks Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: In order to optimize the post-disaster resilience of distribution network in response to extreme events, this paper proposes an improved Harris Hawks optimization (HHO) algorithm to solve the coordination problem between fault reconfiguration and emergency repair in distribution network. First, a two-layer optimization model for coordinated fault reconfiguration and repair strategies is constructed by comprehensively considering the improvement of system resilience during fault repair and the restoration of critical loads after the repair is completed. Secondly, an improved HHO algorithm is proposed to solve the repair model to obtain the optimal repair sequence, and correspondingly, the switch reconfiguration scheme for distribution networks after extreme events is rolled up, so as to obtain the optimal post-disaster distribution network restoration strategy under the framework of organic combination of the two. Finally, the proposed strategy is simulated and verified using the IEEE-33 nodes. The results show that the proposed strategy fully considers the cooperative relationship between fault reconfiguration and repair, and has certain superiority in enhancing the resilience of distribution networks after disasters.

articleTitle: Study on the Aging, Discoloration, and Thermal Behavior of Epoxy Resin Insulators in High-Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Long-term operation of insulating components within high-voltage switchgear can lead to insulating aging under the coupled effects of electrical and thermal stresses. The contacts and busbars within the switchgear may experience abnormal heating due to aging or excessive contact resistance, which is one of the significant causes of switchgear failure. This paper investigates the aging discoloration and thermal aging of insulating components, primarily focusing on epoxy resin insulators. Initially, based on the correlation between the degree of thermo-aging of epoxy resin insulators and their color change, thermal aging experiments are conducted to obtain insulators with varying degrees of aging. The degree of aging is categorized according to the noticeable changes in color. Subsequently, the remaining service life of the insulators at different aging stages is calculated through mass loss experiments and equivalent aging standards. Additionally, the temperature variations of epoxy resin insulators at different aging stages are explored through experimental investigation. The experimental results indicate that under the same experimental temperature, the longer the aging time, the darker the color of the epoxy resin samples. Under identical conditions, there is no significant change in temperature for epoxy resin insulators of different aging degrees.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation of Exciting Capacitance of Self-Excited Induction Generators Based on the Complex Hurwitz Criterion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The extended complex coefficient Hurwitz criterion is utilized for analyzing the stability of the autonomous system of the self-excited induction generator (SEIG), with the objective of exploring its analytical significance. By employing the extended complex coefficient Hurwitz criterion, both the sufficient and necessary conditions for ensuring system stability were derived and the critical exciting capacitance for successful operation of SEIG was computed. These findings illustrate that the employed methodology demonstrates effective and universally applicable when investigating stability aspects related to SEIGs. Besides, the analytical formula about the exciting capacitance obtained in this paper also has certain application value in practical engineering.

articleTitle: The Partial Carbon Footprint of Plate Type Heat Exchanger in Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The partial carbon footprint of use stage accounts for 60% -95% of the whole life cycle for products with long life and high energy consumption, such as boiler, car. While the carbon footprint is difficult for heat exchanger because of its obscure and indirect power consumption during operation. The flow work loss is the difference of fluid flow mechanical work between inlet and outlet of heat exchanger, and is composed of volumetric flow rate, pressure drop and time period. The flow work loss is proposed to account the carbon emission by consumed electric power or pressured steam. The qualification method is justified by the experimental data of a 1.6 ton plate type heat exchanger. The heat exchanger consumes 1.01 kW for hot fluid, 1.07 kW for cold fluid under the standard test condition; the total electrical consumed power is 2.09 kW by the flow work loss per second. Its carbon emission of 3 years of service life is 163.98 tCO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and its electrical work consumed of heat exchanger is 93518 kWh. Its amount of carbon emission is also about 216 times of that of the averaged 0.75884 tCO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> per ton of air coolers during manufacturing.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of Multi-Port Flexible DC Load Balancing Coordination Control Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: In order to solve the complex operating conditions and load imbalance existing in the operation and control of multi-port DC distribution networks, the networking operation mode suitable for multi-port DC distribution networks is discussed, and a hierarchical multi-port DC distribution network coordinated control architecture is proposed. Finally, a coordinated control strategy for multi-port flexible DC load balancing is proposed, and the effectiveness of the load balancing coordinated control strategy is verified through RTDS hardware-in-the-loop simulation. The research conducted has guiding significance for the implementation of stable control engineering of multi-port DC distribution networks.

articleTitle: Sequential Optimization Control Strategy for Alkaline Electrolyzer Cluster in the Green Hydrogen Production System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: This paper presents an optimization strategy for the coordinated control of multiple alkaline electrolyzers (EL) in large-scale green hydrogen production. First, an operational model for a large-scale green hydrogen system with a cluster of EL is established; Then, considering the economy of system, operational balance and start-stop frequency of the alkaline electrolyzer cluster (ELC), a sequential optimization method is proposed to address the multi-objective optimization problem (MOP). Finally, in the simulation, compared to the equal-power operation method with simultaneous start-stop of multiple EL, the proposed method reduces the start-stop switching frequency of the ELC by over 40 %,lowers the operating cost by approximately 1.38 % and maintains the hydrogen production energy balance of ELC. However, the optimization sequence is a key factor that in the process of transforming a MOP into a single objective optimization problem (SOP).

articleTitle: Short Term Load Forecasting Method for Power System Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: A prediction method has been proposed for short-term electricity load forecasting. Collect historical load time series data of multiple power systems and historical exogenous variable time series data at the same time scale according to the set time step, and construct the original dataset; Preprocess the original dataset to obtain a complete and usable sample set; Constructing a sequence to sequence (seq2seq) LSTM-seq2seq load forecasting model using long short-term memory neural networks; Train the LSTM seq2seq load forecasting model constructed based on the sample set; Preprocess the historical load time series data and historical exogenous variable time series data within the set time step before the prediction period, and input them into the trained LSTM seq2seq load prediction model to obtain the power load prediction results during the prediction period. The proposed method can efficiently and accurately achieve short-term power load forecasting.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Altitude on the Corona Onset Characteristics of Aluminium Conductor Steel Reinforced for Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: At present, the influence of altitude on the AC corona characteristics of transmission lines is mainly to treat the conductor as a smooth steel tube, and to study its macroscopic characteristics, but lack of research on its microscopic characteristics. In this paper, based on the theory of gas discharge, the influence of altitude on the corona onset characteristics of the conductor has been studied by considering the structure of the outer strands of the conductor. The calculation method of the corona onset field strength at each position of the outer strands of the conductor was discussed. The corona onset field strength at each position of the outer strands of the conductor at different altitudes from 19 to 4000 m has been analyzed, which has very important engineering value.

articleTitle: Research on the System Stability of Offshore Wind Power under Extreme Wind Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Extreme weather events such as typhoons can easily create extreme wind environments, which have a significant impact on offshore wind power station in Guangdong Province. This article takes the Mingyang Yangjiang Qingzhou IV Offshore Wind project (Yunhua Sea Wind Farm) in Guangdong Province as a measurement point and uses the 2018 CMA best-track data to conduct typhoon simulation. The research shows that as the typhoon continuously moves towards the measurement point, the fluctuation of the wind speed has a huge impact on the power output, power generation, safe operation of the wind turbines, and the stability of the transmission towers of the offshore wind power station. This is mainly manifested during the 93rd to 105th hours when the power output of the offshore wind power station drops to 0, the availability of the wind turbines decreases to 92.5%, and the wind pressure exceeds 0.405 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{KN}/\mathrm{m}^{2}$</tex>, threatening the stability of the transmission towers. Meanwhile, from June to November, the power generation of the offshore wind power station is most affected by typhoons, with a difference reaching 9412.1 MWh.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Intelligent Electricity Metering Apparatus Full Life Cycle Management System Based on AI Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the power grid lean management requirements, the existing smart turnover cabinet has limitations in the degree of automation, failure rate, etc., and has been unable to meet the needs of the full life cycle management of electric energy measuring instruments. For this reason, this paper designs and realizes a smart electric energy measuring apparatus full life cycle management system based on AI image recognition. First, the system adopts a model architecture combining ResNet and EfficientNet, using the deep network robustness of ResNet and the efficient deployment capability of EfficientNet to ensure the accuracy and real-time performance of the system in complex tasks; second, combining with the attention mechanism to optimize the extraction capability of key features, the system designs a customized classification layer to meet the demand of electric energy measuring instruments for multi-category recognition; finally, this paper designs and implements an intelligent electric energy measuring instruments life cycle management system based on AI image recognition. Finally, the system enhances the adaptability to low-light, reflective and other complex scenes through the image preprocessing module. The system realizes the functions of automatic storage and retrieval, real-time monitoring and early warning of measuring instruments, effectively improves the lean level of the whole life cycle management of measuring assets, and provides important support for promoting the modernization of the management of intelligent electric energy measuring instruments.

articleTitle: External Defect Recognition of Lightning Arresters Based on an Improved YOLOv10 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: To address the external defect detection challenges of lightning arresters in power systems, this paper proposes a novel visual detection method, Ar-YOLOv10, based on an improved YOLOv10 model for identifying external defects in lightning arresters. First, we constructed and publicly released a comprehensive dataset of lightning arrester external defects to provide essential data support for related research. The dataset used in this study is publicly available through the Roboflow platform at https://app.roboflow.com/godlizy/arrester-external-defect-dataset/1. Subsequently, we designed comparative experiments to evaluate the performance of four real-time object detection models: Ar-YOLOv10, YOLOv10, RT-DETR, and SSD. Experimental results demonstrate that the Ar-YOLOv10 model achieved a mean Average Precision of 82.12% on the test set, significantly outperforming the other three models. Moreover, Ar-YOLOvl0 exhibited excellent performance across critical metrics, including Precision, Recall, and detection speed. The research findings validate the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed method in real-time detection of external defects in lightning arresters.

articleTitle: An Arc Welding Module of Automatic Equipment for Tubular Terminal with Precise Energy Control Technology Based on PWM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: In order to improve construction efficiency and reduce safety hazards, Zhuhai Power Supply Bureau of China Southern Power Grid has initiated the development and research project of a portable fully automatic construction equipment based on advanced motion control technology for wire stripping, tin dipping, and terminal crimping. The purpose of this paper is to introduce a new spot hot penetration welding technology developed in this equipment. This technology uses PWM to precisely control the energy of the ZVS are generator in automation equipment, precisely controls the heating point, and uses arc welding to spot melt the tin inside the tubular terminal. This technology can achieve precise energy control and rapid internal welding for different types of terminals, moreover can protects the insulating sleeve of terminal from thermal deformation during the tin melting of arc welding process in the new equipment.

articleTitle: A Fast Assessment Method for New Energy Power System Stability Based on Transient Energy Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Aiming at the rapid assessment of the stability of new energy power systems, this paper proposes a transient voltage stability assessment method based on the network reactive energy magnitude (MLE). Firstly, a network energy function based on the response trajectory is constructed based on the Lyapunov function as a measure of the stability of the new energy power system, and then the MLE stabilization criterion based on the network reactive energy is proposed, as well as the stabilization assessment process. Finally, a standard example of CSEE-VS of electromechanical transient in China's actual engineering situation, is used for simulation verification, which proves the correctness and effectiveness of the methodology in this paper.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision-Making Modeling Method for Power Design Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the rapid development and increasing complexity of modern power systems, the power design process faces numerous challenges. Traditional design methods mainly rely on the experience and manual operations of designers, which can no longer meet the high demands for efficiency and accuracy in modern power engineering. This paper proposes an intelligent decision-making modeling method for power design solutions, integrating big data analysis, artificial intelligence, and optimization algorithms to achieve intelligent and automated power design processes. Through an intelligent decision support system, complex design tasks can be completed in a short time, improving design precision and reliability. This paper details the construction methods and processes of the intelligent decision model and discusses its application scenarios in power design.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Influencing Factors of Value Maintenance Rate of New Energy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the rapid development of the new energy vehicle (NEV) market, the issue of value maintenance rate has attracted increasingly more attention from consumers and the industry. Although NEVs are not a new concept, when the electrification trend returns, it creates a stir. Given the continuously growing NEV parc, the depreciation of used electric cars has become a problem of great concern in the market. Beginning with the theory of used car loss and depreciation, the paper combines factors such as battery, technology iteration, policy, brand, etc. to examine and address the problem of why used electric vehicles depreciate in value. Meanwhile, it predicts the circumstances under which used electric cars may stably maintain their values in some period. With the further development and stabilization of NEV technologies and the gradual increase of NEV parc, the challenge of rapid depreciation of used new energy vehicles will be considerably alleviated.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Transmission Lines Based on IGWO-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: As a crucial component of the power system, the normal and stable operation of transmission lines is vital to the production and daily life of electricity users. To ensure the stable functioning of the power system, the study focuses on ten faults in transmission lines. Utilizing MATLAB/Simulink, a simulation model of the transmission lines is constructed. Leveraging the powerful feature extraction capabilities of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), a fault diagnosis model based on CNN is established. To enhance diagnostic accuracy further, the Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) integrated with Levy Flight and Tent Map is adopted to optimize the model, introducing an IGWO-CNN algorithm for transmission line fault diagnosis. Simulation results demonstrate that the fault classification model can accurately categorize all types of faults, and the fault localization model can accurately determine the fault location.

articleTitle: Transformer Top Oil Temperature Prediction Using Deep Learning Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Transformers playa vital role in voltage regulation, and their oil temperature serves as an effective indicator of operational conditions, enabling early fault detection through accurate temperature prediction. However, transformer top oil temperature data often exhibit a combination of linear and nonlinear characteristics, challenging traditional single-model approaches. This paper presents a hybrid ARIMA-LSTM model for high-accuracy prediction of transformer top oil temperature. The ARIMA model is first employed to capture the linear trends in the data, while the residuals—the differences between predicted and actual values—are processed by an LSTM network to learn the nonlinear features. The final prediction integrates both the linear trend and the nonlinear residuals. The ARIMA-LSTM model is validated using real transformer operation data and compared with a standalone LSTM model. Results demonstrate that the ARIMA-LSTM model achieves higher prediction accuracy and lower error rates, providing an effective solution for forecasting complex time series data.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Energy Saving Effect of Air-Conditioning in NEVs and Impact on CAFC Credits
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: New energy vehicles (NEV s), as an important technological route for the replacement of traditional fuel vehicles and energy saving and carbon reduction of automotive industry, have been developing rapidly around the world in recent years, and it is necessary to manage the electricity consumption of new energy vehicles to promote the realization of the national dual-carbon goal. During the actual operation of the car, the use of automobile air conditioning has a greater impact on the energy consumption of the vehicle. An energy-saving effect evaluation program for the air conditioning system of battery electric vehicles is established, and the off-cycle technological preferences that can be declared for battery electric models and their impact on the average fuel consumption credits of enterprises is measured. The energy-saving effect evaluation program mainly focuses on the low-temperature working environment, by measuring the energy consumption and mileage when the air conditioner is turned off at room temperature and turned on at low temperature, and comparing it with the fleet average, and then calculate the energy savings of the air conditioner of battery electric vehicles. This study provides a scientific basis for the development of new energy vehicle air conditioning energy-saving technology and policy formulation, and is of great significance in promoting the green development of the new energy vehicle industry.

articleTitle: Design of Photovoltaic Inverter Based on GaN Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: In grid-connected photovoltaic systems, the main goal is to design a high-efficiency photovoltaic inverter with higher efficiency and control the power injected into the grid by the inverter. This article proposes a design scheme for a high-efficiency photovoltaic inverter based on gallium nitride (GaN) power devices. The inverter uses the wide-bandgap semiconductor GaN as the switching device, combined with the HERIC inverter structure, to significantly reduce power loss and the impact of common-mode current. Experimental results show that the conversion efficiency of the inverter can reach 98.88%, and it has superior performance in improving grid-connected efficiency and reducing harmonic distortion.

articleTitle: The Research on a Lightweight Intelligent Distributed Feeder Automation Model Based on Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of smart grids, Distributed Feeder Automation Systems (DFAS) have become crucial in enhancing the reliability of distribution networks. However, the integration of existing deep learning methods into DFAS faces challenges due to computational resource constraints. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a lightweight intelligent distributed feeder automation model based on knowledge distillation. First, a deep learning-based teacher model is designed, capable of effectively processing time-series data from distribution networks and capturing the complex interrelationships between electrical quantities. Through knowledge distillation, a lightweight student model is developed, employing techniques such as depthwise separable convolution, the Squeeze-and-Excitation module, and a lightweight temporal attention mechanism to achieve efficient model compression. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model maintains over 90% fault classification accuracy, despite a significant reduction in parameters. This research provides a promising solution for improving the operational efficiency and reliability of smart distribution networks.

articleTitle: Production. Storage, Transportation and Simulation Scheme of Hydrogen Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Hydrogen energy is regarded as the most potential clean energy in the 21st century, and it is also a kind of clean energy that is accelerated to be developed and utilized under the background of peak carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality. In order to clarify the methods and technologies of hydrogen energy preparation, storage and transportation, this paper summarizes the specific methods of hydrogen energy production, storage and transportation. The results show that the main methods of hydrogen preparation are fossil fuel reforming, water electrolysis and biomass hydrogen production. Hydrogen storage methods mainly include high-pressure gaseous hydrogen storage, low-temperature liquid hydrogen storage and hydrogen storage materials. The transportation of hydrogen energy mainly includes the transportation of compressed hydrogen, liquid hydrogen, hydrogen storage medium, pipeline and manufacturing raw materials. The role of geological work in the development of hydrogen energy is emphatically introduced in order to provide reference for accelerating the strategic deployment of hydrogen energy in China.

articleTitle: A Short-term Load Forecasting Method Based on HI-Informer-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The issue of load uncertainty in power system is one of the key research directions of the uncertainty of demand response. Accurate power system load forecasting is a crucial prerequisite to ensure the safe and stable of the power grid and the social normal production. Improving the accuracy for load forecasting, the paper proposes the ID-Informer-LSTM model for load forecasting, this model integrates the Historical-Inertia model, the LSTM model and the Informer model using the LSTM model. Experimental results show that the HI-Informer-LSTM model performs excellently in load forecasting, and its forecasting results are highly consistent with the actual observed values, successfully capturing the load trend and seasonal changes. In contrast, other models showed significant errors in some cases and failed to capture the same features effectively.

articleTitle: Hot Spot Temperature Inversion Sensing Method of Cable Connector
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The power system is one of the key national infrastructures. In the complex power system, the three-core cable, as a common transmission and distribution mode, is widely used in cities, industrial areas and remote energy transmission due to its advantages of compact structure and high power supply reliability. The overheating of the three-core cable will seriously affect the insulation life of the cable, and reduce the stability of the distribution network. The cable joint is the weak link of the three-core cable line, and the contact resistance makes the joint more heated compared to the body at present, and it is difficult to directly measure the temperature inside the three-core cable joint. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the temperature rise of the three-core cable joint and propose a method that can reverse the internal temperature of the joint in real time, which is to conduct real-time monitoring for the stable operation of the three-core cable line.

articleTitle: Torque Quality Optimization of Combined-Halbach Array AFPMM with Asymmetric Skewed Poles Based on SMPSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: Due to its high torque density and compact structure, axial-flux permanent magnet machine (AFPMM) shows obvious advantages in direct drive and miniaturization. In order to further adapt the machine to the requirements and improve the performance, an asymmetric bidirectional skewed poles combined-Halbach array rotor structure is proposed and applied to the AFPMM to improve the torque density, suppress the torque ripple and improve the stability of the machine. Firstly, a 3D finite element method (FEM) was used to establish the machine. Then, the XGBoost (eXtreme Gradient Boosting) model was used to predict the machine parameters, and establish high-precision surrogate model. Finally, the speed-constrained multi-objective particle swarm optimization (SMPSO) algorithm was used to optimize the rotor skewing angle, phase shifting angle, permanent magnet (PM) thickness and pole-arc coefficient, aiming at average torque, torque ripple and unit volume magnet torque. Compared with the machine without skewed pole, the machine proposed in this paper showed obvious advantages, the average torque increased by 5%, the torque ripple decreased by 50%, and the unit volume magnet torque increased by 23.5%.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling of Cross-Region Consumption of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Symposium on New Energy and Electrical Technology (ISNEET)
abstract: The rapid development of wind power has brought challenges in terms of consumption and scheduling. This article proposes a research method based on optimized scheduling to address the key issues of cross-region transmission and power consumption in the development process of wind power in China. Firstly, model the uncertainty of wind power output based on wind speed probability model and wind turbine output probability model; Then, an optimization scheduling model is constructed with the goal of minimizing the total system cost, combined with the layout design of wind power transmission channels, to enhance the regulation capability of the power system; Finally, taking the IEEE 39 node system as an example, the configuration effects of different external channel positions are compared and analyzed through simulation. The results show that reasonable planning of the layout of external transmission channels can significantly improve the level of wind power consumption and alleviate transmission pressure, providing theoretical support and empirical basis for cross-region transmission of wind power and optimization scheduling of large power grids.

articleTitle: Collaborative Control Algorithm for Multi-Source Energy Supply Under Load Response Optimization
